reason: A speech interface plugin for DeepSeek Harness that provides per-message and automatic text-to-speech playback plus microphone dictation using configurable cloud speech services or browser speech synthesis fallback.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供消息播报、自动播报和麦克风语音输入，并支持配置阿里百炼、火山豆包或浏览器系统音色。
summaries.en: Adds message playback, automatic announcements, and microphone dictation to DeepSeek Harness using configurable Alibaba DashScope, Volcengine, or browser system speech services.

capabilities: Converts assistant message text to speech for playback
Captures microphone audio for speech recognition
Sends text or speech data to Alibaba DashScope or Volcengine when configured
Uses browser system speech synthesis as a fallback
Stores automatic playback preference in browser local storage
